description: Source code implementing functions for building and configuring Physical Downlink Shared Channel (PDSCH) and Physical Uplink Shared Channel (PUSCH) in 5G NR, including RNTI handling, resource allocation, and power control, following 3GPP specifications.

methods.name: get_pusch_config_f0_0_tc_rnti
methods.description: Configures PUSCH parameters for F0-0 TC RNTI based on cell configuration and resource allocation.

methods.name: get_pusch_config_f0_0_c_rnti
methods.description: Configures PUSCH parameters for F0-0 C RNTI, including CSI report size adjustments.

methods.name: get_pusch_config_f0_1_c_rnti
methods.description: Configures PUSCH parameters for F0-1 C RNTI, including CSI report size and beamforming.

methods.name: get_pusch_config_f0_1_c_rnti
methods.description: Configures PUSCH parameters for F0-1 C RNTI, similar to above with additional CSI and beamforming considerations.

methods.name: build_pdsch_f1_0_si_rnti
methods.description: Builds PDSCH for SI RNTI with specific resource and power configurations.

methods.name: build_pdsch_f1_0_p_rnti
methods.description: Builds PDSCH for P RNTI with specific resource and power configurations.

methods.name: build_pdsch_f1_0_ra_rnti
methods.description: Builds PDSCH for RA RNTI with specific resource and power configurations.

methods.name: build_pdsch_f1_0_tc_rnti
methods.description: Builds PDSCH for TC RNTI with specific resource, power, and redundancy configurations.

methods.name: build_pdsch_f1_0_c_rnti
methods.description: Builds PDSCH for C RNTI with specific resource, power, and scrambling configurations.

methods.name: build_pdsch_f1_1_c_rnti
methods.description: Builds PDSCH for UE-specific C RNTI with beamforming and multiple codewords.

methods.name: build_pusch_f0_0_tc_rnti
methods.description: Builds PUSCH for F0-0 TC RNTI with resource, transform precoding, and HARQ configuration.

methods.name: build_pusch_f0_0_c_rnti
methods.description: Builds PUSCH for F0-0 C RNTI with resource, transform precoding, and HARQ configuration.

methods.name: build_pusch_f0_1_c_rnti
methods.description: Builds PUSCH for F0-1 C RNTI with resource, CSI, and transform precoding configurations.

methods.name: build_pusch_f0_1_c_rnti
methods.description: Builds PUSCH for F0-1 C RNTI with resource, CSI, and transform precoding configurations.
